description: The file contains a JUnit test class 'ImmutableFeaturesTest' for the 'Features' class, testing its immutability, feature management, JSON serialization, and property handling within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior, immutability, and functionality of the ImmutableFeatures class within the Eclipse Ditto modeling framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test method, setting up the 'underTest' Features instance with a predefined feature.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the hashCode and equals implementations of ImmutableFeatures.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableFeatures and its elements are immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatures
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to create ImmutableFeatures with null features throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: emptyFeaturesIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that an empty Features instance reports as empty with size zero.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON serialization of Features produces the expected JSON string.

methods.name: tryToGetFeatureWithNullId
methods.description: Verifies that requesting a feature with a null ID results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: getExistingFeatureReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that retrieving an existing feature by ID returns it successfully.

methods.name: getNonExistingFeatureReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Ensures that requesting a non-existent feature returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: tryToSettNullFeature
methods.description: Ensures setting a null feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setSameFeatureAgainReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Checks that setting the same feature does not create a new Features instance.

methods.name: setFeatureReplacesPreviousFeatureWithSameId
methods.description: Verifies that setting a feature with an existing ID replaces it.

methods.name: setFeatureToEmptyFeaturesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding a feature to an empty Features collection.

methods.name: tryToRemoveFeatureWithNullId
methods.description: Ensures that removing a feature with null ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: removingNonExistentFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Checks that removing a non-existent feature does not alter the Features instance.

methods.name: removeFeatureWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that removing an existing feature results in an empty Features collection.

methods.name: tryToSetNullDefinition
methods.description: Checks that setting a null definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setDefinitionOnEmptyFeaturesCreatesFeatureWithDefinition
methods.description: Tests that setting a definition on an empty Features collection creates the feature.

methods.name: setDefinitionToFeature
methods.description: Verifies updating a feature with a new definition.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromUnknownFeatureDoesNothing
methods.description: Ensures removing a definition from an unknown feature does nothing.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromKnownFeatureWithDefinition
methods.description: Tests removing a definition from a feature that has one.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromKnownFeatureWithoutDefinition
methods.description: Checks that removing a definition from a feature that lacks one does nothing.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertiesWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures setting properties with null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetNullProperties
methods.description: Ensures setting null properties throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setSameExistingPropertiesReturnsSameFeatures
methods.description: Verifies that setting existing properties again does not change the Features.

methods.name: setPropertiesOverwritesExistingProperties
methods.description: Tests that setting properties overwrites previous properties.

methods.name: setPropertiesToFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Validates setting properties on a feature that initially lacks properties.

methods.name: setPropertiesOnEmptyFeaturesCreatesNewFeatureWithProperties
methods.description: Tests that setting properties on empty Features creates a new feature.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that converting Features to JSON yields the expected JSON object.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertiesForNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures that removing properties with null feature ID throws exception.

methods.name: removePropertiesFromNonExistingFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Verifies that removing properties from a non-existent feature makes no change.

methods.name: removePropertiesFromExistingFeatureWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that removing properties from an existing feature updates accordingly.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures that setting a property with null feature ID throws exception.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that setting a property with null JSON pointer throws exception.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullValue
methods.description: Checks that setting a property with null value throws exception.

methods.name: doNotSetPropertyIfItIsAlreadySet
methods.description: Verifies that setting a property to the same value does not change Features instance.

methods.name: overwriteExistingPropertyValue
methods.description: Checks that setting a property with a different value updates the feature.

methods.name: setNonExistingPropertyValue
methods.description: Verifies adding a new property to a feature.

methods.name: setPropertyToNonExistingFeature
methods.description: Tests setting a property on a feature that does not yet exist in Features.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertyWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures that removing a property with null feature ID throws exception.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertyWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that removing a property with null JSON pointer throws exception.

methods.name: removePropertyFromNonExistingFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Verifies that removing a property from a non-existent feature makes no change.

methods.name: removeNonExistingPropertyFromExistingFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Checks that removing a non-existent property from existing feature does nothing.

methods.name: removeExistingPropertyFromExistingFeatureWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that removing an existing property updates the feature accordingly.

methods.name: ensureFeaturesNewBuilderWorks
methods.description: Tests that the Features builder can create a Features instance properly.

methods.name: ensureFeaturesToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Verifies that converting Features to a builder and building again yields an equivalent object.
